hero.title: Curated tech, honestly graded.
hero.subtitle: Second-hand and refurbished laptops, phones and gadgets with clear grading. Check availability instantly on WhatsApp.

why.d: Every unit gets an A/B/C grade with real photos and battery health where applicable.
We never say 'Ready Stock' until stock is confirmed. You know the status from the start.
Order through WhatsApp and get answers from our team, not a chatbot.

steps.d: Use spec, brand and feature filters to match your needs.
Enter your name and WhatsApp number; the message is pre-filled.
We check stock and send the final price and unit condition.
Pay once stock is certain. Delivery within Greater Jakarta.

trust.sla: Replies within 15 minutes during business hours
trust.priceLock: Final price is locked for 24 hours after confirmation
trust.noWarranty: All items are sold without warranty or returns. Condition is disclosed honestly before you pay.

sections.d: We sell second-hand and refurbished items sourced from partner suppliers. Our suppliers offer no warranty or returns, so TechRevive cannot offer them either. That is why we describe condition, grade and any flaws honestly before you pay. Please ask about anything you are unsure of first.
'Check Availability' means stock is not yet confirmed. The final price and stock are confirmed over WhatsApp and then locked for 24 hours. Payment is only requested once stock is certain.
Bank transfer, virtual account or QRIS. Payment details are sent after you approve the quote.

Items are shipped to us first for inspection. They are then delivered by our own team or sent via courier, depending on your address and what we agree at confirmation. Service area: Greater Jakarta. Estimates and delivery fees are given at confirmation.
Your name and WhatsApp number are used only to process your request and are not shared with third parties.
